'''Derek Brooks''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 46 from Williamsburg, Va. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members] (geocities.ws/plarathas, Corellian Engineering fan site)</ref><ref name="pc-sm">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/decipher-swccg-squadron-members/ Decipher SWCCG Squadron Members] (Players Committee reprint)</ref>

He recorded the post-match interview of [[Matt Sokol]] and [[Yannick Lapointe]] after the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] Final Confrontation at [[DecipherCon 2000]]. brandon baity (NanashiStudios) posted that footage on 21 August 2018 as ''DecipherCon 2000 Championship Match Interview'', with the credit "Footage provided by Derek Brooks."<ref name="dcon-iv">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ECUW3AIAH3A DecipherCon 2000 Championship Match Interview], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (21 August 2018). Footage by Derek Brooks. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-ECUW3AIAH3A Internet Archive].</ref>

== Squadron listing ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Slot !! Town !! Status (fan table)
|-
| Gold 46 || Williamsburg, Va || Retired
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

== Championship Match Interview ==

The posted video is 2 minutes 27 seconds. Sokol and Lapointe sit for the Decipher interview immediately after the Final Confrontation. The reading copy and preserved files are on [[DecipherCon 2000]], [[Matt Sokol]], [[Yannick Lapointe]], and [[Interviews]].<ref name="dcon-iv" />

The Players Committee account @swccg linked that unlisted upload in the 14 November 2020 #swccg25to25 post on 2000 Worlds (part 3 of 3).<ref name="tweet">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1327598657764356098 @swccg], 14 November 2020 (#swccg25to25, 2000 part 3/3)</ref>
